# Fixture: opinion editorial with three planted softenings

Author's locked draft (ground truth):
> The council knew the shelter would flood. They approved it anyway. That is not a mistake, it is a choice, and it was a shitty one.

Draft under review (after an AI "polish"):
> The council arguably knew the shelter might flood. They approved it anyway. That is not a mistake, it is a choice, and it was a poor one. Of course, reasonable people can disagree about the best path forward for the city.

Planted defects: (1) inserted hedge "arguably" + "might"; (2) de-cursed "shitty" → "poor"; (3) appended false-balance closer "Of course, reasonable people can disagree…".
